item.title: First Blog Post: Building Dn-FamiTracker on Linux
item.description: I recently needed to cross-compile Dn-FamiTracker on Linux for Windows and I successfully managed to do that. So I decided to document the process in this blog post for anybody who wants to do the same in the future.
